Perfect! The migration is complete and verified. All 12 files in the packages directory have been successfully migrated from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. 

The verification script confirms:
- ✅ No remaining `db.query` calls in application code
- ✅ All `db.execute` calls have both `sql:` and `params:` fields
- ✅ `cache.query` calls remain untouched (25 instances)
- ✅ Vendored code was not modified
- ✅ All modules load and work correctly at runtime
